segments.name: Targeted oncology therapies
segments.description: Develops and commercializes innovative targeted oncology therapies, led by LYMPHIR for relapsed or refractory CTCL.
segments.evidence: The Company operates through a single operating and reportable segment which is focused on developing and commercializing innovative targeted oncology therapies.

revenueModel.text: Revenue comes from direct sales in the U.S. and royalty income, with partners marketing products outside the U.S.
revenueModel.evidence: This commercialization strategy is anticipated to result in a combination of direct sales revenue, and royalty income, as well as incremental operating expenses and greater working capital requirements.
